entities.text:
8.	AT EACH COLUMN STRIP, PROVIDE A MIN OF 2 BOTTOM REBAR IN EACH DIRECTION PASSING THRU THE COLUMN CORE (I.E. THRU THE COLUMN LONGITUDINAL REBAR). SEE INSET DETAIL "B". THESE REBAR SHALL HAVE HOOKED ENDS AT THE EXTERIOR SUPPORTS.
9.	DISTRIBUTION OF TYPICAL REINFORCEMENT ACROSS ENTIRE SLAB:
	TYPICAL REINFORCEMENT SHALL BE ARRANGED WITH UNIFORM SPACING CALLED OUT ON PLANS FOR EACH DIRECTION, TOP AND BOTTOM, ACROSS THE ENTIRE SLAB.
10.	DISTRIBUTION OF ADDITIONAL REBAR ACROSS DESIGN STRIPS:
	ADD REBAR SHALL BE DISTRIBUTED/SPREAD ACROSS THE ENTIRE STRIP WIDTH AS SPECIFIED BELOW. DO NOT BUNDLE ADD REBAR IN ANY CASE.
A.	AT MIDDLE STRIP TOP AND BOTTOM POSITION, AND COLUMN STRIP BOTTOM POSITION, ADD REBAR SHALL BE DISTRIBUTED WITH UNIFORM SPACING ACROSS THE STRIP WIDTH.\PB.	AT COLUMN STRIP TOP POSITION, 75% OF ADDED REBAR SHALL BE UNIFORMLY DISTRIBUTED ACROSS A 1800mm  WIDE "BAND" CENTERED ON THE COLUMN CENTER LINE. THE REMAINING 25% SHALL BE EVENLY DISTRIBUTED WITHIN THE REMAINDER OF THE COLUMN STRIP OUTSIDE THE 1800mm WIDE "BAND". IF THREE OR LESS ADD TOP REBARS ARE SPECIFIED, EVENLY PLACE WITHIN THE WIDTH OF THE COLUMN.\PC.	EACH ADD REBAR LOCATION SHALL BE ADJUSTED AS NEEDED TO MAINTAIN ADEQUATE CLEAR SPACING FROM OTHER REBAR, INCLUDING TYPICAL REINFORCEMENT.\PD.	THE EXTEND OF ADD BARS SHOWN ON THIS DETAIL IS THE MINIMUM CODE REQUIREMENT IN CASE OF BAR LENGTHS SHOWN ON THE PLANS HAS LONGER LENGTH THE PLANS BAR LENGTH SHOULD BE USED OTHERWISE THE EXTENSION SHOWN ON THIS DETAIL SHOULD BE FOLLOWED.
